detailed_description:
The target video is a living sumi ink painting in <Subject 2>: every stroke keeps its wet brushed texture as it moves, ink flows and drips like real liquid ink on paper, and the hairline moon and cloud outlines stay thin, clean and steady.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The black cat pushes off the brush stroke of ink with her hind legs and springs upward on a rising diagonal toward the upper right, front paws reaching for the moon, body stretching long. Her tail whips down and back behind her and unrolls into a huge swirling ribbon of wet black ink that sweeps around in a great arc from the lower left, flinging drops and splashes across the paper. The camera tilts up at moderate speed in one continuous move to follow her, the brush-stroke ground sliding down and out of the bottom of the frame while the hairline moon slides down into the right half of the frame. The camera is still tilting up as the shot ends on <Picture 2>, the cat at the height of her leap before the moon. No cut or transition occurs.

overall_soundscape:
Claws scratch the paper as she pushes off, then a rushing whoosh of air carries the leap. A wet slap of flung ink and a spray of drops pattering onto paper follow the sweep of her tail.
